incidents.name: CUT value-preservation LP pricing
incidents.notes: valuePreservationByRemoveLP() priced the CUT compensation owed on an LP removal from the live PancakeSwap USDT/CUT reserve ratio, so a large in-transaction swap skewed that spot price and paid out ~275bn CUT instead of ~61bn.
